name: Calvin Lutz Farms
tagline: Whoville at Calvin Lutz Farms opens with corn maze and pumpkins
description: Calvin Lutz Farms is an on-farm market in 8576 Chief Rd, MI, selling produce straight from the field. Because everything is sold where it is grown, selection follows the local harvest calendar. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
